3_inside_purity_boundary.why: tests/unit/truth_engine/test_no_cloud_imports.py::_source_files() globs Path('src/driftzero').rglob('*.py'), which is recursive. Any file under src/driftzero/ is scanned, including a new store/ subpackage.

4_would_fail_m0_purity.answer: YES — three separate tests, demonstrated empirically
4_would_fail_m0_purity.method: the guard's own FORBIDDEN_ROOTS and _imported_roots() were applied to a minimal candidate adapter written outside the repository; nothing was placed inside src/driftzero/

failures.reason: 'google' is in FORBIDDEN_ROOTS; imported roots were ['driftzero', 'google']
third-party surface would become ['google'], violating third_party <= {'pydantic'}
the banned literal 'google.cloud' appears in the source text

4_would_fail_m0_purity.also_would_fail: test_importing_both_packages_loads_no_forbidden_module only if the adapter became transitively reachable from driftzero.models or driftzero.truth_engine; a leaf module under driftzero.store is not imported by those packages, so the runtime scan would not catch it on its own.

5_persistence_port_already_defined.evidence: the only Protocol in src/driftzero/ is ArtifactRepository in tools/artifact_mutation.py. The four concerns T092 names are concrete classes with no interface: Workflow (models/workflow.py), ActionLedger (truth_engine/actions.py), ProofStore (proof/store.py), and idempotency keys carried as stable action_id lookups inside truth_engine/actions.py.
5_persistence_port_already_defined.consequence: there is currently no seam for T092 to implement against. A port has to come from somewhere.

6_adapter_can_live_outside_m0.answer: YES, and the repository already does exactly this three times
6_adapter_can_live_outside_m0.why_it_does_not_violate_T092: T092's substance is 'implement the Firestore persistence adapter for workflows, action ledger, proofs, idempotency keys'. Only the file path conflicts with the purity boundary, not the behaviour. Every acceptance-relevant property of the adapter is reachable from a sibling package.

7_spec_amendment_required.answer: YES — a path correction, nothing more
7_spec_amendment_required.scope: one path in one task line; no change to what T092 must do

8_clean_composition_root_solution.answer: YES, and it requires zero M0 modification
8_clean_composition_root_solution.mechanism: Python Protocols are structural. A port declared OUTSIDE the boundary is satisfied by the existing M0 concrete classes as they already are — no inheritance, no registration, no edit to a frozen file.
steps: declare the persistence ports in src/driftzero_cloud/ports.py, shaped to the existing ProofStore / ActionLedger / FieldEvidenceStore / SourceProcedureStore surfaces
implement src/driftzero_cloud/firestore.py against those ports using google-cloud-firestore
let src/driftzero_console/service.py — which already constructs SourceProcedureStore(), ActionLedger() and FieldEvidenceStore() at lines 560-585 — select the in-memory or Firestore implementation
keep domain truth in the Truth Engine: Firestore stores records, it never adjudicates
8_clean_composition_root_solution.existing_seam: src/driftzero_console/service.py is already the composition root and is already outside the purity boundary
